cards.summary: This fan-animated nature documentary depicts the leisurely lifestyle and behavior of Torterra in a lush forest and meadow environment. A male Torterra wakes up, slowly treks to a lake for water, briefly attempts to pursue a female mate, and quickly returns to resting.
